title: incident-template template variables
description: Values for templates/incident-template.md.j2 and templates/incident-template.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from incident-template.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

artefact_date.description: On what date did this incident occur, as YYYY-MM-DD? The day the behaviour started, not the day the postmortem was written.

artefact_title.description: What is this incident called? A phrase a reader recognises six months later - what broke and for whom, not the ticket number.

failure_mode_id.title: Failure mode id
failure_mode_id.description: Which taxonomy failure mode is this, as its `fm.x.y` id? It must match an entry in taxonomy.json - an id that does not resolve makes the incident uncountable.

incident_severity.title: Incident severity
incident_severity.description: How bad was this while it was happening? Rate the impact users actually took, not the effort it cost to fix.

linked_methodology_slug.title: Linked methodology slug
linked_methodology_slug.description: Which methodology slug does that taxonomy entry point at? Copy it from the entry rather than picking one - the link is what turns an incident into a mitigation.

owner_full_name.description: Who owns this incident record and its follow-ups? One named human, and the person a reader with a question should go to.
